narrative.problem: The backend now serves GET campaign-emails/{id}/preview, but the CLI has no command for it, and the CLI contract copies still describe 0.1.18.
narrative.scope: One command registration, one help line, two tests, the 0.1.19 version bump (package, lockfile, README, changelog), the regenerated publish contract, the refreshed parity fixture and the release manifest copy.
requirements: Bump the CLI to 0.1.19 and keep every contract copy equal to backend main.
changes: src/commands.js registers the command; src/args.js lists the flag.
tests/campaign-email-preview.test.js covers the request and the missing flag.
Publish contract regenerated; parity fixture rebuilt from backend main (220 operations, 227 commands); manifest copy matches backend main.
decisions: Reuse the existing campaignEmail flag and workspace() builder, as email-state does.
Contract files are generated by repository scripts, not hand edited.
narrative.zero_debt: No new abstraction, flag, dependency or compatibility shim. One command line beside email-state.
narrative.security: Read-only GET with an id that goes through the shared path encoder. Secret and static scans clean; no declared package sources for the dependency scanner.
narrative.regression: Full suite passed 1040 of 1040 before the last commit; affected files pass 18 of 18 on both base and head; release-contract:check is OK.
narrative.compatibility: Existing commands and flags are unchanged. Only a new command and the version move forward.
risks: The parity fixture and manifest copy depend on backend main at 78edb3b35; the backend contract PR that refreshes the manifest is still open, so the manifest copy must be re-checked against main after that PR merges.
narrative.rollback: Revert the commits; the CLI returns to 0.1.18. Nothing is published until the owner runs npm publish.
gaps: Two untested-caller findings about src/cli.js were classified wrong: the new tests spawn the real binary.
The coverage floor is not checked automatically: no coverage summary file exists.
Dependency scanner had no declared package sources.
